title: Plan the media path before the meeting grows
description: Choose a topology and room shape. The model keeps client upload, media-server egress, TURN relay traffic, and the first scaling limit visible at the same time.

topologies.label: Peer mesh
topologies.detail: Every participant sends a separate copy to every other participant.
topologies.bestFor: Two to four participants and no media server

topologies.label: Selective forwarding unit
topologies.detail: Each participant publishes once; the SFU forwards selected layers to receivers.
topologies.bestFor: Interactive group calls and adaptive layouts

topologies.label: Media mixing unit
topologies.detail: The server decodes, composes, and re-encodes one mixed stream per participant.
topologies.bestFor: Constrained clients or a server-controlled composite
